speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: asked the Minister for Transport with regard to feedback on motor dealers stockpiling motorcycle COEs to resell at a higher premium (a) what is the progress of LTA's investigation into this issue; (b) what is the Ministry doing to address this issue; and (c) whether the Ministry will shorten the validity period of these COEs to curb their speculation.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: This is the preferred model for the motorcycle market as it allows buyers to take delivery of their motorcycles immediately.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Based on the feedback from one of my residents recently, he said that they are very concerned because of this stockpiling of COEs.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: So, he suggested that the Ministry may wish to consider two things.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Because currently, deposit is only $200; that is why dealers go and stockpile and take a chance.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: With regard to the Member's question on whether to shorten the validity period of the TCOE to three months instead of the current six months.
